method: Read event-specific F1 published articles and official race classifications where relevant for 22 events, and rewrote 11 bilingual narratives to fit the supported facts. No independent editorial approval, full verification of all 105, all-source uptime or rights clearance is claimed. Latest pass: 20 additional bilingual narratives checked against live Formula 1 race reports or historical articles on 2026-10-27. Explicitly avoided claiming independent FIA PDF review, media licensing, or final editorial approval.
